Old advance_tile issues K+2 at the start, consumes next LDS fragments during compute, then waits/barriers at the end. A precise slot-hazard and retirement trace is needed before a scheduling transplant.
Three-pass SFA startup can be amortized across 21888+ WG dispatches; a captured WG is not equivalent to the full kernel.
single_mechanism_hypotheses: If interior ATT shows critical next-tile LDS supply/end-wait, port only 9020 midpoint publish/retire scheduling. Preserve C64bit base, bounds, and all matrix/scale addresses. Evaluate prologue independently.
Raw scale issue/publish is statically plausible; prioritize physical C-write traffic and interior ATT first.
ATT_priority: First capture true winner [65536,16384,1536] with exact 96B kernargs and full FUNC identity. Use bounded profile/ATT rotations to avoid excessive buffers.
Only then use optional K384/K16384 same-M/N controls under the large-output contract; ordinary small-M launchers cannot exercise 9030.
The ten C outputs span 2–8GiB. A fixed 51-address Event pool can exceed VRAM at 8GiB; root must budget memory before a full Event sweep.

diagnostic_order: No-profiler timing, useful work, and physical traffic baseline
TCP/TA tagram, LFIFO, UTCL1, and request latency
Wave dependency versus issue wait, with ATT phases

counter_pass_recommendations.interpretation: Check dynamic work and 32B physical request units against useful/padded work and output bytes. Measure large-output writes.
Same-pass LEVEL/REQ gives average EA-interface cycles. Distinguish L2 hits, channels, and SoC flow; it is not pure HBM latency.
Separate upstream backpressure, translation, inflight requests, and address distribution. Use only verified gfx950 event definitions.
Use same-pass wave-quad-cycle ratios when units match. Issue wait differs from memory-return wait and barrier wait; bank-conflict counts are not wall time.
Retain raw instance values and dimensions. Prior raw CSV GRBM sum differed from max, and JSON max did not match timestamps. Do not invent absolute utilization/occupancy or a fixed correction factor.

ATT_contract.capture_identity: Use the current official module; verify exact function template, descriptor, kernargs, and capture code.json PC mapping.
ATT_contract.wave_scope: Capture eight full waves for 9020/9030 or four for 9022 if the decoder permits; record stitched SIMD/CU selection. Correlated waves are not independent repetitions.
ATT_contract.timing: On gfx9, successful issue = time + stall; duration already includes stall. Wait dependencies establish queue membership, not individual memory-return latency.
phase_splits: K0 / scale producer / K1 / publication barrier
scale and matrix LDS reads, then first MFMA
final MFMA / BF16 / C store / endpgm
ATT_contract.EXEC_policy: An instruction event with EXEC=0 does not prove active-lane traffic; identify producer waves and masked stores.

limits: No ATT, counter, GPU, or build execution was performed for this review.
Static scale VMEM serialization establishes a candidate opportunity, not a critical path or full-call gain.
9020 short/long representatives use different fixed/runtime bodies; the 9022 pair uses one body; only K1536 is an actual 9030 winner.
Do not assume current MI355X CU/resource/specification values from MI300 paper constants.
Keep rejected global prologue and packed-scale directions distinct from fresh single-mechanism hypotheses.
